t: The Port For Real This Time
s: The author details a challenging app porting process, focusing on leveraging AI, refactoring from ZeroMQ to WebSockets, and migrating from JSON file persistence to FastHTML's MiniDataAPI, all while managing complex SSH key configurations for Git operations.
sub: Transitioning from ZeroMQ to WebSockets for real-time communication
Lightweight data persistence using JSON files and FastHTML's MiniDataAPI
Managing multiple SSH keys for private Git repositories
